verdict.rationale: Clerk's first-party docs say Enterprise SSO lets users sign in with their IdP credentials, naming Azure AD (Entra), Okta and Google Workspace, with user data synced into Clerk. The docs also state that SAML and OIDC are both supported protocols. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of enterprise SSO setup, and deeper documentation of configuration details such as per-connection setup, attribute mapping and provisioning behavior.
